subject: Startups
title: Trade Secrets vs. Patents
description: One-minute skill: Trade Secrets vs. Patents.

hook.text: Coca-Cola never patented its formula. After 130 years, it's still a trade secret. Patents eventually expire.

buildup.text: Trade secrets protect information that derives value from being secret: algorithms, recipes, customer lists, processes.

discovery.text: Unlike patents, trade secrets have no filing cost and no expiration date.

twist.text: Patents require public disclosure. By filing one, you teach competitors your invention.

climax.text: The choice depends on detectability: if competitors can reverse-engineer it, patent it. If they can't, keep it secret.

punchline.text: Some things are better kept than filed.

quiz.question: What is the key advantage of trade secrets over patents?
options: They never expire and require no filing
